edges.note: DIA official James Lacatski read 'Hunt for the Skinwalker' by Kelleher and George Knapp, contacted Bigelow, visited the ranch, and relayed the experience to Sen. Harry Reid; the two later co-authored 'Skinwalkers at the Pentagon' (2021).

edges.note: Davis is repeatedly identified in the record as a former employee of Puthoff's EarthTech International; both authored DIRDs in the same series.
